description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for managing Multi-Link Devices (MLDs) and their links within a wireless LAN context. It includes structures for MLD configuration, grouping, and management, as well as functions for registration, status checking, and neighbor link retrieval.

classes.name: wld_mld_t
classes.description: Represents a Multi-Link Device (MLD) with its configuration, links, and group association.

classes.name: wld_mldLink
classes.description: Represents an individual link within an MLD, including its SSID, link ID, and status.

classes.name: wld_mldMgr
classes.description: Tracks all MLD groups and manages initialization state.

methods.name: wld_mld_initMgr
methods.description: Initializes the MLD manager.

methods.name: wld_mld_deinitMgr
methods.description: Deinitializes the MLD manager.

methods.name: wld_mld_registerLink
methods.description: Registers a new link to an MLD based on SSID and unit.

methods.name: wld_mld_unregisterLink
methods.description: Unregisters a link from the MLD based on SSID.

methods.name: wld_mld_checkMLDStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of an MLD for a given SSID.

methods.name: wld_mld_getLinkSsid
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID associated with a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_getLinkSsidByLinkId
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID for a link by its link ID.

methods.name: wld_mld_getLinkName
methods.description: Gets the name of a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_setPrimaryLink
methods.description: Sets a link as the primary link for its MLD.

methods.name: wld_mld_getPrimaryLink
methods.description: Retrieves the primary link of an MLD.

methods.name: wld_mld_getPrimaryLinkSsid
methods.description: Gets the SSID of the primary link.

methods.name: wld_mld_getPrimaryLinkIfName
methods.description: Gets the interface name of the primary link.

methods.name: wld_mld_getPrimaryLinkIfIndex
methods.description: Gets the interface index of the primary link.

methods.name: wld_mld_setLinkId
methods.description: Assigns a link ID to a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_resetLinkId
methods.description: Resets the link ID of a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_getLinkId
methods.description: Retrieves the link ID.

methods.name: wld_mld_getLinkIfName
methods.description: Gets the interface name of a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_isLinkActive
methods.description: Checks if a link is active.

methods.name: wld_mld_isLinkEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a link is enabled.

methods.name: wld_mld_isLinkUsable
methods.description: Checks if a link is usable.

methods.name: wld_mld_checkUsableLinkBasicConditions
methods.description: Checks basic conditions for link usability.

methods.name: wld_mld_saveLinkConfigured
methods.description: Saves the configured state of a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_setLinkConfigured
methods.description: Sets the configured state of a link.

methods.name: wld_mld_isLinkConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a link is configured.

methods.name: wld_mld_isLinkActiveInMultiLink
methods.description: Checks if a link is active within a multi-link context.

methods.name: wld_mld_countNeighLinks
methods.description: Counts neighboring links.

methods.name: wld_mld_countNeighActiveLinks
methods.description: Counts active neighboring links.

methods.name: wld_mld_countNeighEnabledLinks
methods.description: Counts enabled neighboring links.

methods.name: wld_mld_countNeighUsableLinks
methods.description: Counts usable neighboring links.

methods.name: wld_mld_getNeighLinkByRad
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring link by radio.

methods.name: wld_mld_getNeighLinkByMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring link by MAC address.

methods.name: wld_mld_firstUsableNeighLinkByFreq
methods.description: Gets first usable neighbor link sorted by frequency.

methods.name: wld_mld_firstNeighLink
methods.description: Gets the first neighbor link.

methods.name: wld_mld_nextNeighLink
methods.description: Gets the next neighbor link.

methods.name: wld_mld_getMldByUnit
methods.description: Retrieves an MLD by its type and unit number.
